svg.aria-label: Nested NVStorage architecture: physical containers, in-memory roles and derivation paths

text.tspan: NVStorage · object containment and processing relationships
One collection on one Mac · process, directory and file containment with labeled functional groups
Nesting shows the labeled boundary. Functional subheadings group similar roles. Select an operation to trace its objects.
Live notes → frozen values / fixed bytes → checked history → local commit
Required work → current rows + editing context → complete live model
Repository → saved incoming bytes → checked action groups → accepted history
Saved objects → owned temporary file → verified repository installation
File observations → retained preview → admitted change
Validated surviving input → verified replacement → activation / copy
